digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud S3-backed live test suite
propositions: A new read-only live test suite for Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation over S3-backed store is missing coverage of real Cloud volume and diversity across REB and DIG projects.

The test suite must enforce structural read-only invariants by monkeypatching all AcliClient mutating methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, etc.) to raise exceptions and verify per-project issue counts remain identical before and after each scenario.

Test scenarios must validate that compute_snapshot fetches both REB and DIG projects from live Jira at real volume with correct per-project attribution, and that an unknown mapped project key fails closed rather than silently succeeding.

The isolated S3 store uses a throwaway git-remote-s3 prefix (never production) with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, deleted in teardown, and the suite must pass ruff/mypy linting and be integrated into CI as a dedicated manually-dispatched jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job.
Unknown project keys must fail closed during compute_snapshot (raising an error) rather than returning an empty or partial snapshot.
bridge_preview in dry-run mode must remain read-only and scoped per project with zero Jira mutations, verified by structural guard and per-project count assertions.
